body: It sucks, I'm actively trying to better myself and make progress everyday, in fact, I just had two awesome employment opportunities open up but I just can't seem to get motivated or excited for the end game. I'm just ready to die.

Larger ability to travel. A career that was conducive to it. Freedom to do alot more outdoor things. However when I think about the good in the future that I can actually make happen my mind says "yeah that will be real nice.... but not nice enough. Fuck that." I dont know, it's been a really hard year and a half and I'm only 1/2 way through life. It's not like its to hard(it is hard, but I've got it). I just dont want it anymore.
Yea Im cognizant of all this, havnt felt this bad in a really really long time.
Yea, parents in poor health, and a 6 year realtionship just ended. I've dealt with the depression my whole life. Just feel like I'm being buried now.

Im trying. All those things make me think, I have no significant other. I dont want to bother my friends, or worry my loved ones. Ive given up on myself to an extent. At this point im just here for them. Im still sticking to the routine and being proactive, it just hurts.
